leverage.exposure: No leveraged position, and the live bid does not create one — it is funded entirely from cash and leaves a healthy remainder, so the rule that a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the whole matchday is untouched. Offers do not debit the balance until they clear, which this run confirmed twice. Spending power is far larger than cash because of the floor, and should not be reached into. The real exposure is thinness rather than leverage: at eleven players any deletion is a formation failure, and while the German window shuts tonight, the Turkish and Saudi windows run past the matchday lock, so deletion risk does not end with the German deadline. The previously feared exposure has eased — the fringe midfielder was signed by his club in the summer on a long contract and deadline-day reporting has that club buying rather than selling, with no item suggesting he leaves. If the pending bid lands, the squad reaches twelve and becomes robust to any single deletion in any position, and that resilience is a real part of the case for it.

binding_gap: A third attacker, and it is now bid for rather than merely identified. Two attackers is what reduces the squad to one rigid formation and forces a player with no points history into the fielded eleven; one attacker fixes the formation count, removes the zero-scorer from the XI, and is simultaneously the largest points upgrade available from a single purchase. If the bid loses, this gap reopens as the top priority and the cheap Elversberg midfielder becomes insurance rather than a pass.

verdict.headline: The bid is placed on the right player and the wrong bid is gone — both confirmed from live data, not assumed.
verdict.headline_short: The bid is placed on the right player and the wrong bid is gone — both
verdict.detail: The bid is placed on the right player and the wrong bid is gone — both confirmed from live data, not assumed. Georg initially bid on the wrong Gomis, caught it, and corrected it; the mistaken offer shows zero offers against it now, and the Leipzig attacker shows exactly one, Georg's. He is currently the sole bidder with over a day still to run. Nothing else needs doing today. Sylla is banked at more than the recommended figure, Maluze was lost narrowly on a bid that was again too low, and the consequence of that loss is the one thing to keep hold of: the squad is at eleven with a single legal formation, so the Bernardo sale that was scheduled for tonight stays CANCELLED and nobody is sold until the attacker actually lands.

sell.reason: Nothing, and this reverses a standing instruction. At eleven players with a single legal formation every sale is a hundred-point penalty inflicted by Georg's own hand, which outranks any amount of cash banked. Bernardo specifically: the sale written for tonight carried two mandatory gates and the second failed — it required the squad to still be twelve after Sylla left, which required Maluze to land, and Maluze was lost. The call named this exact branch in advance. He becomes sellable again the moment the attacker lands, and at that point there is a ranking change worth holding onto: Lokonga becomes sellable on the same arithmetic at the same moment, and he is the better sale — fewer points given up, more cash banked, the worst points-per-euro in the squad, and a faster daily bleed. That reverses the order every previous run has used.

buy.reason: DONE, pending resolution. The bid on Tidiam Gomis, Leipzig attacker, is live at the recommended figure and Georg is the only bidder on the listing, with well over a day before it resolves. No further action — and specifically, do NOT shave the bid now that it looks uncontested. Kickbase is pay-your-bid rather than second-price, so being sole bidder does not earn a discount, and the temptation to lower it is a trap: the three measured clearings in this value band all landed around the same premium, comfortably above where a reduced bid would sit, so a lower number would very likely lose to a late rival. Losing this player costs far more in points than the couple of million a reduction would save, and every single error in the calibration table is the same error of bidding too low. Leave it alone. The case for him is unchanged and was the cleanest verification this ledger has run: listed at exactly his market value, no status flag, value rising, marked fit on his profile, absent from his club's injured list, starts in both competitive appearances, a dated coach quote naming him in the starting eleven before the opener, and a matchday one start in which he set up both of the first two goals before a tactical withdrawal with the game won. He is a third attacker, which is the binding gap, and he replaces a zero-scorer in the fielded eleven with a high scorer. Everything else on the board remains rejected on points-per-euro, the newest Freiburg midfielder ask included — more than three times worse per point than this buy, and it would have consumed the cash that made it possible.

standing.name: Tidiam Gomis

FITNESS AND STARTER STATUS: CONFIRMED, and this is the rare case where every source agrees. Ligainsider profile (correct slug is /tidiam-gomis_36962/, NOT _46855 which 404s) marks him FIT and gives 2026/27: 2 appearances, 2 STARTS, 128 minutes (BL 64, DFB-Pokal 64), 0 goals, 3 assists. He STARTED MD1 on 29.08.2026, Leipzig 3:0 Gladbach, and provided TWO assists - 26' for Baku's opener and 49' for Nusa's second - before being taken off at 64' for Nkunku with the game won; rb-fans.de 30.08.2026 confirms the substitution was tactical, not an injury, and that Demichelis started him as a striker. Dated 21.08.2026: "Demichelis legt sich fest: Gomis startet gegen Trier" - the coach naming him a starter out loud. He is NOT on Leipzig's injured list (that is Gebel/Kreuzbandriss 10+ months, Baumgartner, Ouedraogo). DATE TRAP CLEARED, and it is a nasty one a future run will hit: searching his name surfaces an RB Leipzig tweet "Tidiam #Gomis (Verletzung des Innenbandes am linken Sprunggelenk) ... wieder teilintegrativ in das Mannschaftstraining" plus absolutfussball "Kurz nach Vorbereitungsauftakt: Erste ernstere Verletzung bei RB" - the tweet id 1957813620252766670 resolves to 19.08.2025, LAST SEASON's pre-season. Both are stale by a year. Note also that Ligainsider's generic "voraussichtliche Aufstellung" page for Leipzig lists a different XI (Vandevoordt in goal, Esteve starting) than the one that actually played MD1 (Nicolas in goal, Esteve benched) - that page is a pre-season projection and the actual MD1 lineup outranks it. WHY HE FIXES THE BINDING GAP: Georg carries only TWO attackers, which is why 5-3-2 is the ONLY legal formation and why Amoako (ap 0) is forced into the fielded XI as a third midfielder. Gomis is a THIRD ATTACKER, which unlocks 5-2-3 and 4-3-3 and pushes Amoako out. Best XI now, 5-3-2: Baumann 129; ter Horst 143, Matsima 138, Minjae 110, Bernardo 62, Widmer 29; Nusa 226, Lokonga 44, Amoako 0; Gregoritsch 195, Guirassy 180 = 1256 ap. With Gomis in 5-2-3: 129 + 482 (all five DEF) + 270 (Nusa, Lokonga) + 551 (Gregoritsch, Guirassy, Gomis) = 1432 ap. That is PLUS 176 ap on the fielded eleven for one purchase - by far the largest single-move gain available, because a 0-scorer leaves the XI and a 176-scorer enters it. VALUE: 9.400.000 / ap 176 = 53,4k PER POINT. Georg paid 67,8k/pt for ter Horst this morning and that was the good buy of the day; Ljubicic cleared at 184k/pt, Jatta would be 264k/pt, Aebischer 226k/pt, Deman 430k/pt. Nothing else on this board is close. THE BID, and why it is above the measured cluster: Kickbase board listing, so benchmark the HIGH cluster and never the median (median is +2,98% and is pure manager-ask noise). In the 6-10M mv band the measured high cluster is unusually tight - ter Horst +27,61% (our bid WAS the clearing price), Ljubicic +27,34%, Vagnoman +27,26% - three independent datapoints inside 0,35 of a percentage point. That cluster centre on mv 7.014.962 is 8.951.800. The recommended 9.400.000 is +34,00%, deliberately ~6 points ABOVE that ceiling, for four reasons: (1) ap 176 is the best of every comparable in the band, so more of the 17 rivals want him; (2) 28h of runway is maximum exposure; (3) tonight's 20:00Z tick will reprice him UPWARD (mvt 1, +406.847 in 24h), lifting every rival's willingness to pay before he resolves; (4) every single error in the calibration table is the same error - bidding too low. Maluze was lost this morning by 325.004 on a 5.500.000 recommendation, and Nguefack was lost three times. DO NOT READ THE MALUZE +308,77% RECORD AS LICENCE TO BID +300% HERE - that premium was enormous only because Maluze's mv (1.425.004) had not caught up with his ap (194). Gomis's mv already prices him as a 7M player, so the correctly-priced 6-10M band applies, not the cheap-body band. AFFORDABILITY: cash 16.877.522, so 9.400.000 leaves 7.477.522 and opens NO leveraged position - the negative-balance-scores-zero rule is untouched. Spending power is 68.353.651 but that is irrelevant here; stay inside cash. UNWIND CEILING: one buy permits exactly one sale, which is precisely what re-enables the Bernardo sale afterwards (see the master plan). MD2: Leipzig away at Werder Bremen 2026-09-05T13:30Z, comfortably inside the MD2 window. RISK, stated honestly: Kickbase is pay-your-bid, not second-price, so if nobody else bids, 448.200 of the premium over the cluster centre is wasted. Accepted - losing ap 176 costs far more than 448.200.

In the 6 hours to 2026-09-01T00:40Z, David bought THREE players straight off the Kickbase board at or just BELOW mv, all with no fielding value: Pimpong (14920, Frankfurt ATT) 2.751.290 vs mv 2.760.937 = MINUS 0,35%; Guether (13629, Union Berlin MID) 2.941.280 vs mv 2.950.479 = MINUS 0,31%; Konoplia (7774, Gladbach DEF) 1.211.009 vs mv 1.219.089 = MINUS 0,66% - and get_player confirms Konoplia carries st=1, "Partial tear of medial collateral ligament in the knee - out for several weeks". Linguini07 paid 1.721.810 for Awortwie-Grant (8984, Paderborn DEF) against mv 1.545.176 = PLUS 11,43%, and get_player confirms st=1, "Lateral ligament injury - out for about 6 weeks". PhiL95 and Goran1992 ran the usual same-minute round trips (Quetant buy 1.637.900 / sell 1.650.813; Gendrey buy 2.558.595 / sell 2.564.595; Mohya buy 9.901.900 / sell 9.912.711) - margins of a few tenths of a percent on the daily tick. THIS IS MOTION, NOT POINTS. Georg optimises for points; buying a man who is out for six weeks to earn 0,3% on a market-value tick consumes a squad slot he cannot spare at 10 players and scores zero on MD2. The Awortwie-Grant clearing is however a genuine premium datapoint worth keeping: +11,43% over mv on a contested Kickbase listing for an injured player, which sits between the manager-ask low cluster and the Ebnoutalib/Campbell high cluster and further supports bidding the HIGH cluster on Kickbase board listings. NO REVERSAL - the flip mechanism is separately dead this run anyway: kb_context measures ZERO manager asks below mv.

killed_this_run.name: Elfadli
killed_this_run.why: NEW Kickbase listing 2026-08-31T23:28:46Z. Daniel Elfadli, HAMBURGER SV defender (tid 6), mv 2.288.995 listed at exactly mv, st=0, no points history this season, expires ~2026-09-02T19:15Z - by far the LONGEST runway of any cheap body on the board, which is the only thing recommending him. NEWS, dated: Ligainsider profile - fit, no injury, but 2 substitute appearances and ZERO starts in 2026/27 (1 Bundesliga sub, 96 min; 1 DFB-Pokal sub, 95 min), did not start MD1, and the latest item is 28.08.2026 "Elfadlis Situation beim HSV bleibt schwierig". A confirmed non-starter scores nothing. REJECTED ON TWO GROUNDS: he is a DEFENDER, and Georg's problem is MID/ATT depth - he already has 4 DEF and both live big bids (ter Horst, Maluze) are DEF, so adding a fifth or sixth defender does not improve the shape; and at 2.288.995 he is more than double Skov (2717, Union MID, mv 1.104.430) who does the body job in the position that actually helps. REVERSAL: only if every outfield MID and ATT body under 3M is gone from the board AND the squad is still under 11 inside 24h of the lock - his long expiry makes him the last-resort filler, nothing more. ALSO COVERS WOJCIK (15256): NEW Kickbase listing 2026-09-01T00:38:41Z, WERDER BREMEN defender (tid 10), mv 3.185.713 at exactly mv, no points history, expires ~2026-09-01T15:19Z, and he carries st=2 - a non-fit status flag. A flagged, historyless defender at 3,19M is the worst of all three objections at once. AVOID outright, no reversal.

movers.reason: No flip clears its cost this run. The lock is far enough away that the window is technically open, but the mechanism is absent: zero manager asks sit below market value, for the sixth run running, so there is no spread to capture. The rivals' activity is not a counter-example — one bought Skov and dumped him back to Kickbase inside ninety minutes for a gain of a few thousand on a player with no minutes this season, which is the pattern the ledger already logged as motion rather than points, and it vindicates the standing avoid on him precisely.

fitness.sweep: The pending buy is clean on every source: marked fit, absent from his club's injured list, two starts from two appearances, and a dated coach quote naming him a starter. Two traps sit on top of him and a future run will hit both. First, searching his name surfaces a club tweet describing an ankle ligament injury plus a report of the first serious injury of pre-season, and both are from LAST season's pre-season, stale by a full year. Second, the generic probable-lineup page for his club lists a different eleven than the one that actually played matchday one, including a different goalkeeper — the real lineup outranks the projection. In the squad, only Bernardo carries a flag and it is not new: a knock picked up at Köln that explains his early withdrawal there. He is marked fit externally and appears on no injured list, so treat him as doubtful for the home fixture against Dortmund rather than ruled out. No squad member is newly injured, suspended or benched.
